Behind the experiment +

A portfolio experiment by Ro / Zenpai, an IT & CS student in Phnom Penh. The classifier comes from Group 3’s Deep Learning-Based Southeast Asian Food Recognition and Nutritional Estimation project for ITM-390: Machine Learning.

Reported best validation accuracy: 81.7%. Reported test accuracy: 82% on 415 photos. These are historical project results, not a new evaluation of this browser version. The supplied checkpoint’s filename differs from the training log.

Below 50% confidence, the model says “Not sure.” The original 224 × 224 resize and normalization are preserved. Browser image decoding can cause small differences in scores.
